caption: The drawing depicts a single clear glass goblet positioned centrally on a plain background. The goblet has a wide, outwardly flaring rim with a thin dark edge at the top, followed by a bowl-shaped body that is decorated with grooved, slightly segmented vertical lines. The stem of the goblet is rounded and features a bulbous, double-knobbed form that transitions into a flat, circular base. The glass is illustrated with shades of gray and white, with highlights and light reflections indicating its transparency and the smooth, reflective surface. The background is a pale, beige color and does not include any additional objects or decorations.
title: Compote
